 Hon'Ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, J. 
Hon'Ble Kunal Ravi Singh, J. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner; Ms. Uttara Bahuguna, learned Addl.
Chief Standing Counsel for State respondents and Shri Pranjal Mehrotra,
learned counsel for National Highway Authority of India (in short "Authority").

2. The instant writ petition has been preferred for following relief:-
"(i) issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding and directing the respondents to provide the compensation to the petitioner for extra utilization of land to the tune of 0.0810 Hectare being utilized from the land plot no.1447 without acquisition within specific period with interest."
3.

Learned counsel for the petitioner states that the petitioner had earlier instituted Writ-C No.6720 of 2025 (Naseem Ahmad v. State of U.P. & Ors.) with the allegations that he has been paid compensation for an area measuring 370 sq. mtrs. only of plot no.943, whereas the total area of land affected by acquisition of the said plot is 1180 sq. mtrs.

entities.text: Writ-C No.6720 of 2025 (Naseem Ahmad v. State of U.P. & Ors.)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner, therefore, prayed for a direction to the State respondents to pay compensation for the entire area, which got affected as a result of acquisition.
In the said proceeding, the State respondents had supplied written instructions according to which the total area of plot no.1447 and 943, which was acquired is 1202 sq. mtrs.
The petitioner had been paid compensation on 22.6.2020.

It was further stated that the Arbitration Case No.190 of 2020 at the behest of the petitioner is pending before the Arbitrator under Section 3G (5)
of the National Highways Act, 1956.

In this backdrop, the said writ petition was disposed of on 1.4.2025 asking the respondents to decide the claim of the petitioner regarding non-payment of compensation amount for an area measuring 810 sq. mtrs. within twelve weeks.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is aggrieved with the non-disbursement of compensation for an area, which is utilized by the respondents for road widening.
5. Learned counsel for the respondents have stated that disputed facts have been raised in the instant writ petition, which cannot be adjudicated under Art.226 of the Constitution of India.

They further submit that for redressal of grievance of tenure holders, claiming certain right/title over their land, the State Government had issued detailed Government Order dated 12.05.2016, which provides that in case the claimant files claim supported with requisite documents, the same would be considered by the District Level Committee for ensuring adequate compensation in the light of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short the 'Act 2013').

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
He submits that once the efficacious remedy is Nasim Ahmed vs Union Of India And 3 Others on 7 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/141687269/
2 available to the petitioners, the matter should be relegated to the District Level Committee, which may examine the claim of petitioners within a reasonable time and submit its report to the Chairman/District Magistrate, who may accord adequate compensation accordingly.

entities.text: Nasim Ahmed vs Union Of India And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and the relief prayed in the instant matter, we dispose of the instant petition with liberty to the petitioners to make fresh representation along with certified copy of the instant order before District Level Committee constituted under the Government Order dated 12.05.2016 within two weeks.

In the event, such representation is made,
the District Level Committee shall consider the claim of the petitioners and ensure that the proceeding shall be finalised expeditiously, preferably within twelve weeks, thereafter.

(Kunal Ravi Singh,J.) (Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.) November 7, 2025 SP/
